skill_name: Explain why artificial intelligence (AI) is a powerful tool for predicting customer behaviour.
workflow: AI is a powerful tool for predicting customer behaviour because it is able to analyze vast amounts of data quickly and accurately. By processing customer interactions, transactions, and other data, AI can gain an understanding of customer preferences and habits. This understanding can then be used to deliver targeted and personalized experiences, making it easier for customers to find what they are looking for and in turn, increasing customer loyalty and engagement.
